$comment: Acknowledged Skill/Runtime/Hook composition violations that predate the
One entry per skill per rule. Every entry must name the issue that tracks
fixing it, so the exemption is temporary and visible rather than silent
(criterion validator-signal-hygiene). There is no blanket/wildcard form.
When a listed skill stops violating its rule the validator FAILS until the
entry is deleted, so this list can only shrink.
Baseline recorded 2026-08-11 against 47 skills; 9 entries across 7 skills,
